articles.title: Newlywed Couple's Pilgrimage Ends in Tragedy: SUV Crashes Into Container Truck at 150 kmph, 3 Killed
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A pilgrimage and holiday trip turned tragic after a speeding SUV carrying a newlywed couple and their relatives crashed into a container truck on the Ara–Buxar four-lane road under the Bihiya Police Station limits in Bihar's Bhojpur district on Sunday morning.

body.html:
A pilgrimage and holiday trip turned tragic after a speeding SUV carrying a newlywed couple and their relatives crashed into a container truck on the Ara–Buxar four-lane road under the Bihiya Police Station limits in Bihar's Bhojpur district on Sunday morning.

According to police, the SUV was travelling from Delhi to Deoghar in Jharkhand when it rammed into the rear of a container truck at an estimated speed of around 150 kmph. The impact was so severe that the vehicle was mangled beyond recognition, and locals, along with police personnel, had to make strenuous efforts to extricate the occupants from the wreckage.

Traffic DSP Manoj Kumar Sudhanshu said four people were travelling in the SUV. Three of them, including a husband and wife, died on the spot, while the fourth occupant sustained serious injuries and is undergoing treatment.

The deceased have been identified as 32-year-old Prakash Singh, his 28-year-old wife Pallavi Singh, and Prakash's cousin, 24-year-old Sourav Singh. The injured, Kumar Gourav, is a friend of Sourav.

Police said the bodies have been sent to Ara Sadar Hospital for post-mortem examination, and the victims' families have been informed. A case has been registered and further investigation is underway.

According to family members, Prakash, an engineer with a reputed company in Jharkhand and a native of Bihar's Saran district, had married Pallavi in February this year. The couple, along with their relatives, had recently visited the Pashupatinath Temple in Nepal and later travelled to Manali in Himachal Pradesh. They were returning to Deoghar from Noida, where they had stayed with relatives, when the fatal accident occurred.

Locals said Prakash was driving the SUV, while Pallavi was seated beside him in the front passenger seat at the time of the crash.

articles.title: Drunken Tourists Create Chaos at Mussoorie Police Post, Abuse Cops, Spit at Officers
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A late-night altercation involving two couples from Delhi created chaos on Mussoorie's Mall Road and at the Library Police Post after one of the women, allegedly under the influence of alcohol, created a public disturbance.

body.html:
A late-night altercation involving two couples from Delhi created chaos on Mussoorie's Mall Road and at the Library Police Post after one of the women, allegedly under the influence of alcohol, created a public disturbance. Videos of the incident have gone viral on social media, raising questions over the police's decision to release the group after counselling.

According to police, the incident took place between 3 am and 4 am on Sunday. Two young men and two young women, who had come to Mussoorie for a weekend trip, were on Mall Road when one of the women allegedly became heavily intoxicated and started creating a ruckus. Unable to control the situation, her companions called the police for assistance.

Police reached the spot and brought the group to the Library Police Post. However, the situation allegedly escalated further inside the police station.

According to reports, the two women allegedly entered the cabin of the police post in-charge, shouted abusive language and misbehaved with police personnel. One of the women allegedly locked the inspector's cabin from inside, while the other reportedly kicked the door from outside. The group also allegedly abused police officers who attempted to intervene.

Reports further claimed that one of the women spat at police personnel and mocked them before stepping outside the police station. She allegedly continued creating a disturbance on Mall Road, misbehaved with passersby and was also seen hitting her companion with a slipper.

Several bystanders recorded the incident on their mobile phones, and the videos have since gone viral on social media.

Mussoorie Police Inspector Devendra Chauhan said the group was counselled at length after being brought to the police station. Once the situation was brought under control and the woman calmed down, they were safely sent home.

According to Mussoorie Police, after the group apologised for their behaviour and submitted written apologies, they were released and later returned to Delhi.

The incident has sparked debate on social media, with many questioning why no legal action was taken despite allegations of public nuisance, abusive behaviour and misbehaviour with police personnel. Police have not announced any criminal case in connection with the incident.

articles.title: 3 Months After Wedding, Husband Allegedly Kills Wife With Girlfriend, Flees to Nepal Before Arrest
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A 25-year-old man was arrested for allegedly murdering his 22-year-old wife just three months after their marriage with the help of his alleged girlfriend in Haryana's Manesar.

body.html:
A 25-year-old man was arrested for allegedly murdering his 22-year-old wife just three months after their marriage with the help of his alleged girlfriend in Haryana's Manesar. Police claimed the duo planned the murder to continue their relationship before fleeing to Nepal to evade arrest.

The case came to light on May 22 after the victim's mother filed a complaint at Manesar Police Station, alleging that her daughter, Madhu, who had married Ankit on February 19, had gone missing a day earlier. She also expressed suspicion over the involvement of Ankit and his family after they allegedly failed to provide any information about her whereabouts and discouraged the family from approaching the police.

Police initially registered a kidnapping case. Later the same day, Madhu's decomposed body was recovered from a locked bathroom in a private building on Kasan Khoh Road in IMT Manesar after locals complained of a foul smell. Investigators later identified the room as the rented accommodation of Rajni Devi.

The victim had suffered a gunshot wound to the head, following which police added murder charges to the case and intensified the investigation.

During the probe, police arrested Ankit, who runs a tobacco shop in Manesar, and Rajni Devi, 38, a resident of Haryana's Jhajjar district who worked at a beauty parlour. Investigators said the two had allegedly been in a relationship for nearly three years and had also undergone a marriage ceremony.

According to police, the murder was planned in Rajni's rented room. On May 21, Ankit allegedly took Madhu there, where the two accused allegedly shot her dead as part of a pre-planned conspiracy.

Investigators said the pistol used in the crime had been purchased from Uttar Pradesh around two months before the murder and was allegedly procured specifically to carry out the killing.

Police said the motive behind the murder was Ankit's relationship with Rajni. After the crime, the two allegedly fled to Haridwar and later crossed into Nepal. They remained absconding until June 30, when they returned to India and were arrested by the Manesar Crime Branch.

Both accused have been produced before a court and remanded to five days of police custody. Police said efforts are underway to recover the murder weapon, gather additional evidence and ascertain whether anyone else assisted the accused in concealing the crime or helping them evade arrest.

articles.title: Ambulance Blocked by Stunt Bikers in Bengaluru; Viral Video Sparks Massive Outrage
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A group of reckless bikers allegedly blocked the path of an ambulance carrying a patient and performed dangerous wheelies despite the vehicle's siren blaring, in an incident that has sparked widespread outrage.

body.html:
A group of reckless bikers allegedly blocked the path of an ambulance carrying a patient and performed dangerous wheelies despite the vehicle's siren blaring, in an incident that has sparked widespread outrage.

According to reports, the incident occurred at around 2:30 am on July 4 between Goraguntepalya and Yeshwanthpur in Bengaluru.

The ambulance, carrying a patient in need of urgent medical attention, was travelling with its siren on. However, five to six bikers allegedly occupied the road, preventing the ambulance from getting a clear passage while continuing to perform dangerous stunts.

A video of the incident, now circulating on social media, shows the bikers riding ahead of the ambulance, with several pillion riders not wearing helmets. The footage also shows the patient lying inside the ambulance during the ordeal.

The incident has triggered sharp criticism, with many social media users demanding strict action against those responsible for obstructing an emergency vehicle and endangering lives.

Police said they are examining CCTV footage to identify the bikers involved. A case will be registered and appropriate legal action will be taken based on the findings of the investigation.

articles.title: Good Samaritan Robbed in Seconds: Fake Bike Fall Used to Steal Expensive Phone in Hyderabad
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A shocking theft has come to light from Hyderabad's Saroornagar area, where two conmen allegedly stole an expensive mobile phone by exploiting a passerby's willingness to help. The entire incident was captured on CCTV and the footage has gone viral on social media.

body.html:
A shocking theft has come to light from Hyderabad's Saroornagar area, where two conmen allegedly stole an expensive mobile phone by exploiting a passerby's willingness to help. The entire incident was captured on CCTV and the footage has gone viral on social media.

According to reports, the incident took place in a residential locality under the Saroornagar Police Station limits. The accused allegedly staged a fake accident by pretending that their motorcycle had fallen on the road.

Believing the incident to be genuine, a passerby stopped to help. As one of the accused distracted the victim by asking for assistance in lifting the motorcycle, his accomplice quietly removed the victim's expensive smartphone from his shirt pocket.

The accused then fled the spot on a motorcycle without a registration number. The victim realised his phone had been stolen only after the duo had escaped.

The entire incident was captured on a nearby CCTV camera. The viral footage has sparked widespread concern, with many social media users warning that such incidents could discourage people from helping those genuinely in need.

Police are expected to examine the CCTV footage to identify and trace the accused. No official statement regarding arrests has been issued so far.

The incident has also prompted safety advisories, with people urging the public to remain alert while assisting strangers and to keep valuables in secure pockets or bags to reduce the risk of theft by diversion gangs.

articles.title: I'm Not Your Slave': UP Cop's Heated Exchange With Women at Police Station Goes Viral
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A video purportedly showing a police officer arguing with a group of women at the Madhuban Police Station in Uttar Pradesh's Mau district has gone viral on social media, triggering criticism over the officer's conduct.

body.html:
A video purportedly showing a police officer arguing with a group of women at the Madhuban Police Station in Uttar Pradesh's Mau district has gone viral on social media, triggering criticism over the officer's conduct.

According to reports, the incident took place on July 4, when a group of women visited the police station to submit a complaint against the opening of a liquor shop in their locality.

The viral video allegedly shows the inspector becoming agitated as the women demanded immediate action. During the exchange, the officer is purportedly heard saying, "I'm not your slave... You have brought four or six people with you... I will take action right now," while warning that he would "set their minds right."

The authenticity of the viral video and the circumstances leading to the confrontation have not been independently verified.

Police officials are yet to issue an official statement explaining the incident. It remains to be seen whether any departmental inquiry or action will be initiated after verification of the facts.

The video has sparked debate on social media, with many users questioning the conduct expected from police personnel while interacting with members of the public.

articles.title: Husband Catches Wife With Alleged Boyfriend, Dramatic Confrontation Outside UP Police Station Goes
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A dramatic confrontation unfolded in Uttar Pradesh's Hamirpur district after a man allegedly caught his wife with her alleged boyfriend and took both of them to a police station, where a heated argument broke out outside the premises.

body.html:
A dramatic confrontation unfolded in Uttar Pradesh's Hamirpur district after a man allegedly caught his wife with her alleged boyfriend and took both of them to a police station, where a heated argument broke out outside the premises. A video of the incident has since gone viral on social media.

According to police, the incident took place around 9 pm on July 2 in Sumerpur town.

The complainant alleged that he married the woman, a resident of the Maudaha area, in 2021. He claimed that she continued to remain in contact with her alleged boyfriend even after their marriage, leading to frequent disputes between the couple.

The man further alleged that his wife has filed cases of dowry harassment, maintenance and divorce against him, all of which are currently pending before the court. Despite the ongoing legal proceedings, he claimed that she continued to meet her alleged boyfriend.

According to the complaint, the man received information on the night of July 2 that his wife was with her alleged boyfriend in the vegetable market area of Sumerpur. He reached the spot, confronted the two and brought them to the Sumerpur Police Station, seeking legal action.

A verbal altercation and commotion reportedly took place outside the police station during the incident, and a video of the scene later surfaced on social media.

Sumerpur Police Station in-charge Pawan Kumar Patel said a complaint has been received from the man and both parties appeared before the police. He said the matter is under investigation and further legal action will be taken based on the findings of the inquiry.

articles.title: Student in ₹4 Lakh Gambling Debt Allegedly Robs Woman, Pushes Her Into Well; She Survives 21-Hour
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A 21-year-old college student was arrested for allegedly kidnapping, robbing and attempting to murder a 55-year-old daily wage worker by pushing her into an agricultural well in Telangana's Karimnagar district.

body.html:
A 21-year-old college student was arrested for allegedly kidnapping, robbing and attempting to murder a 55-year-old daily wage worker by pushing her into an agricultural well in Telangana's Karimnagar district. The woman survived inside the well for nearly 21 hours before being rescued by local farmers.

According to police, the accused, identified as Dhamma Dinesh Reddy, was addicted to online gambling and betting and had accumulated debts of nearly ₹4 lakh. Investigators said he planned the robbery to repay his debts and attempted to kill the victim to prevent her from identifying him.

The case began on July 1 after the victim, Tangarala Lakshmi, failed to return home. Her son lodged a missing person complaint, following which police registered a missing case.

The investigation took a dramatic turn the next morning when villagers rescued Lakshmi from a deep agricultural well near Nustulapur village after receiving her cries for help.

During questioning, Lakshmi told police that a stranger had approached her with an offer of work at his farm. The accused allegedly booked a Rapido bike and took her towards Thimmapur village. As the area had CCTV cameras and public movement, he later shifted her onto his own motorcycle and took her to a secluded spot near Nustulapur.

Police said the accused allegedly robbed Lakshmi of around 5 grams of gold jewellery, 20 grams of silver anklets and cash before pushing her into the well.

Investigators said Lakshmi initially managed to stay afloat by holding onto a rope inside the well, but the accused allegedly cut the rope after noticing she had survived the fall.

Despite this, Lakshmi, who knew how to swim, reached another cable attached to a motor pipeline and held on throughout the night. She remained trapped inside the well for nearly 20 to 21 hours before local farmers rescued her the following morning.

Karimnagar Police Commissioner Ghaus Alam said investigators traced the accused using Rapido booking records, CCTV footage and mobile phone analysis. During interrogation, the accused allegedly confessed to the crime.

Police also arrested a jewellery trader for allegedly purchasing the stolen gold ornaments, knowing they were stolen property.

Dhamma Dinesh Reddy has been arrested and produced before the court. Police said further investigation into the case is underway.

articles.title: Mobile Torch Instead of Headlights? Viral Video of Karnataka Bus Sparks Outrage Over Passenger
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A Kalyana Karnataka Road Transport Corporation (KKRTC) bus was allegedly operated without functioning headlights, forcing the conductor to use a mobile phone torch to help the driver navigate a dark road.

body.html:
A Kalyana Karnataka Road Transport Corporation (KKRTC) bus was allegedly operated without functioning headlights, forcing the conductor to use a mobile phone torch to help the driver navigate a dark road. A video of the incident has gone viral on social media, triggering widespread concern over passenger safety.

The incident reportedly took place on the last KKRTC bus service from Kalaburagi to Chincholi, a journey of around 90 kilometres.

The viral video shows the bus being driven on a pitch-dark road without headlights, while the conductor shines a faint mobile phone torch to assist the driver. It is not known at what point during the journey the headlights stopped working, but passengers were left with no option except to continue travelling under unsafe conditions.

The incident has sparked a political row, with Opposition parties targeting the Congress government in Karnataka.

The JD(S) condemned the incident, alleging that the driver was forced to risk passengers' lives due to administrative failure. The party also accused the government of adopting a "step-motherly" attitude towards the Kalyana Karnataka region.

In a post on X, the JD(S) claimed that new buses purchased using Kalyana Karnataka Regional Development Board (KKRDB) funds had been diverted elsewhere, while old buses that should have been sent to the scrapyard were still operating in the Chincholi section. The party termed the Transport Department's negligence "highly condemnable" and demanded immediate action against the officials responsible.

BJP national spokesperson Shehzad Poonawalla also criticised the Karnataka government over the incident. In a social media post, he described it as a "shocking and criminal state of affairs" and alleged that despite paying high taxes, people in Karnataka were being left with poor infrastructure, unsafe public transport, corruption and administrative failures.

articles.title: Speeding Baleno Mows Down Two Men in Gurugram, Occupants Flee Leaving Victims Fighting for Life
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Two men, including a graphic designer, were critically injured after a speeding Baleno car allegedly rammed into them while they were standing by the roadside in Gurugram's Sector 75.

body.html:
Two men, including a graphic designer, were critically injured after a speeding Baleno car allegedly rammed into them while they were standing by the roadside in Gurugram's Sector 75. The occupants of the car fled the scene immediately after the crash without stopping to help the victims, police said on Saturday.

According to police, the impact of the collision threw both men several metres away, leaving them with severe injuries. They were rushed to a hospital, where they remain in critical condition.

CCTV footage of the incident shows the two men standing by the roadside moments before the Baleno ploughed into them at high speed. Initial investigation and eyewitness accounts suggest that three young men were inside the car, and all of them escaped from the spot after the accident.

Police said the vehicle was bearing a temporary registration number. Investigators are analysing CCTV footage and using the temporary registration details to identify and trace the accused.

Gurugram Police have registered a case and launched an investigation. ACP Crime Naveen Sharma said efforts are underway to identify and arrest the accused at the earliest based on the available video evidence and vehicle details.
